page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, with a catchword-like signature "GEORGII" in small capitals below it, and a woodcut ornament below that. No margin notes.

main_text.p:
Graiísque vix notus fuis,
Cultu Latino nunc superbus ambulans
Vates vetultos provocat.
Hunc fuscitare qui potueris mortuum,
Fors & meos fraterculos
Sanare penitus si minus queas, tamen
A fauce mortis eruës.
Nec id laboro delicato in ocio
Vt suauiter curent cutem:
Satis superque est si maligne victitent,
Pannis & annis obsiti,
Laceri flagellis, aridi, famelici,
Quae vita digna est fratribus:
Diuque viuant & poenas luant diu,
Mortémque timeant & velint.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the verse is a printer's device and is not transcribed. The verse lines are printed with the lines of each stanza run together; the ornament and the catchword-like word "GEORGII" are its signature line. Some letters are faint and may be misread in places, notably "Graiísque" and "Vates".
